title: openapi-orb run record, version 1
description: What one openapi-orb command ran, on what, and what it found: written as <report_name>.run-record.json when a command's run_record parameter is true. Fields are only ever added within version 1; a change that would break a reader gets a new schema URL.

command.description: The orb command that wrote the record.

outcome.description: passed: no findings. findings: findings failed the step. findings-reported: findings, passed because report_only is true. error: a check did not complete, or checked nothing, so there is no verdict, and the step failed.

exit_code.description: 1 when the outcome is error, else 0. The step's own exit code also depends on report_only.

ci.description: The CI job the command ran in: a CircleCI job (from CIRCLE_BUILD_URL, CIRCLE_SHA1, CIRCLE_JOB and the project), or a GitHub Actions run (from GITHUB_SERVER_URL, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_RUN_ID, GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT, GITHUB_SHA and GITHUB_JOB); null elsewhere.

working_directory.description: The absolute directory the command ran in. Relative paths in arguments and results are relative to it.

tool.description: The tool the command ran: vacuum, oasdiff, or the script on the PATH that runs Schemathesis.

arguments.description: The arguments the tool ran with. lint and breaking run their tool once per document, and name the document <spec> (and the base <base>). URLs lose their userinfo, query and fragment.

target.description: What was compared or tested, when it isn't a file: breaking's base (base_ref, base_commit, merge_base, base_file) and contract_test's url and spec. null otherwise.

inputs.description: The files the result depends on, by role: the documents, the ruleset, ignore and policy files, the base file, the generated document, the Schemathesis configuration.

sha256.description: null when the path isn't a regular file.

counts.description: The command's own summary of what it found, such as the results by severity, the breaking changes, or the operations tested and the failures.

results.description: One entry per document, for breaking: whether it was new at the base or compared, and its changes. null for the others.

reports.description: Every report the command wrote, with its SHA-256.

path.description: The binary, or the script that runs Schemathesis, on the PATH.

version.description: What the tool reports as its version; empty when it reports none.

install.description: How the orb installed the tool, from the record its install command left beside it: a release binary (vacuum, oasdiff) or a locked Python environment (Schemathesis). null when there is none, or when it describes another file than the one that ran.

asset.description: The release asset the binary came from.

asset_sha512.description: The SHA-512 the checksum table holds for the release, which the binary was checked against; empty when it wasn't listed.

verified.description: true when the binary was checked against the orb's checksum table.
true when every installed file was checked against the orb's lock for the release.

lock_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the lock installed; null when unverified.

source.description: uv: a CPython uv downloaded and checked against the SHA-256 it carries. system: the python3 on the PATH. path: an interpreter named by its path.

uv.description: The uv version that installed it.

index.description: The package index, without userinfo, query and fragment.

venv.description: The environment the tool runs in.

packages.description: What uv pip list reported in the environment.
